This repository is a travel roadbook builder (an agent skill plus a dependency-free static template). When asked to build, import, update, check, or publish a travel roadbook, follow `skill/SKILL.md` and its references in `skill/references/`; `AGENTS.md` at the root lists the commands and the rules that do not bend (no invented facts, no booking references or passport numbers in data, no push/deploy/purchase/messaging without explicit permission).
